businessDescription: Global web3 education and acceleration platform — free bootcamps, builder challenges, mentorship, and community for 480,000+ developers across 180+ countries learning blockchain development.
voice: Enthusiastic and builder-focused — speaks peer-to-peer with developers, celebrates learning by doing, and frames every topic around what you can build and earn in web3.
targetAudience: Beginner to intermediate developers globally who want to break into web3 — motivated by hands-on projects, real prize pools, ecosystem partnerships, and a community of peers building alongside them.

hardConstraints.rule: Always cite sources inline with hyperlinks.
Never make up statistics — only use numbers that appear in the research notes.
hardConstraints.example: If no stat is found, write 'data unavailable' rather than estimating.

hardConstraints.rule: Every post must have a clear thesis stated in the introduction.
hardConstraints.example: First paragraph ends with a specific claim or framing the post will explore.

hardConstraints.rule: Never hype web3 without acknowledging real barriers — credibility depends on honesty.
hardConstraints.example: Acknowledge learning curves, ecosystem volatility, or job market realities when relevant.

softPreferences.preference: Speak to builders, not spectators — frame content around what the reader can create.
softPreferences.example: Don't explain what Solidity is in the abstract; explain what you can build with it.
These are the words the target audience uses; using them signals authenticity.

softPreferences.preference: Keep paragraphs short — this audience reads on the go and scans before committing.
softPreferences.example: Under 5 sentences per paragraph. Use code snippets or numbered steps for technical content.

softPreferences.preference: End with a community call-to-action — a challenge to join, a project to fork, a community to enter.
softPreferences.example: 'Ready to ship your first smart contract? The next Rise In bootcamp starts [date].'

avoidTopics: investment advice or price predictions for specific tokens or projects
content that dismisses web3 skeptics without engaging their concerns
overpromising income or career outcomes without evidence
